archetypes.name: dyn-run-log-paths
archetypes.rationale: Path rebasing behavior changed for absolute input and record files.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the run-log path normalization change and tests. Focus on callers that may have relied on pseudo-absolute input-file or record-file rebasing, and verify log-root rebasing still behaves as intended. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
